propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date arguments and `--output json|text` format flags, then render the full metric registry over the specified range.

The command entry point must wire into the CLI dispatcher as a single explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm (not a frozenset route) that imports and calls the metrics module after ensuring store initialization.

The metrics command must import the `rebar.metrics` package (not just the registry module) to trigger reader module registration and hydrate the REGISTRY, then evaluate each MetricSpec by passing a context object with repo_root, since, and until to registry.evaluate().
The render loop must isolate faults by wrapping each evaluate() call in try/except, rendering failed metrics as unavailable rather than crashing the entire command.

JSON output (default) must emit `{"since": <str>, "until": <str>, "metrics": {<id>: {value fields} | {unavailable fields}}}` and text output must list one line per metric in registry order showing id, lens, source, and value-or-unavailable status.

The command implementation must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (portability guard verified by source scan), and help text plus routable subcommand registration must be added so the command appears in overview and help coverage tests pass.
